page.overview:
Who is Brooklynn?

Brooklynn, often called "B" and affectionately nicknamed "Superstar" is the tritagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and the overarching protagonist of its sequel series Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. She was 13 years old during the events of Camp Cretaceous and is 20 years old during the events of Chaos Theory. She became Kenji Kon's girlfriend in the first series but the two broke up sometime before the events of Chaos Theory. In Camp Cretaceous, she was voiced by Jenna Ortega, and in Chaos Theory, she is voiced by Kiersten Kelly.

She was presumed dead in Chaos Theory, supposedly dying to the One-Eyed Allosaurus. However, at the end of Season 1, it is revealed that she is alive, but lost her left forearm to the Atrociraptor Ghost, has cut most of her hair, and went into hiding under the name Sydney.

Brooklynn later pretended to be an an ally of Soyona Santos, in order to find a way to bring down her illegal dinosaur trade, which forced her to reject the opportunity to return to her friends side in the end of Season 2 to keep them safe from Santos. But this temporarily cost her Sammy Gutierrez's and Kenji Kon's trust. But after Santos' arrest, Brooklynn returned to her friends' side at the end of Season 3 and made amends with them by the end of Season 4.

Brooklynn is likely American; due to her accent. But she used to live in London, capital of the United Kingdom with her fathers. She learned how to fix radios and cars and other things like that with her fathers. At some point in her life, although possibly during the time she was ten, Brooklynn became a vlogger, traveling the world and gaining sponsors to make interesting videos and her followers are known as "Brooklanders" which also includes Sammy Gutierrez. As a student, Brooklynn never went to high school and was taught exclusively by online tutors. Before going to Isla Nublar, Brooklynn had had already been on various adventures, such as climbing Mount Everest, and diving with hammerhead sharks, one of which she said she hit one in Hawaii, possibly to avoid getting bitten by it.
